title: Shell by the Shore
summary: A meditative piece about shells and the seashore, exploring digraph sounds and the rhythm of waves through repetitive language.

pages.scene: A single pristine white shell lying on wet sand, light catching its curves
A quiet morning beach, mist rising, all is silent and peaceful
A child gazing at the shell, wondering, with a soft questioning expression
Close-up of shell detail, showing delicate texture and fragile edges
Another shell nearby, weathered and broken, showing age
Many shells scattered in the sand, each unique, waiting to be discovered
Shells being gently tumbled by waves, making soft musical sounds
Figure holding a shell, watching the sunset over water, complete peace

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Seashore tranquility, weathered beauty, quiet wonder
